friction_formulation.value: regularized Coulomb extension on the serial direct normal Lagrange active-set solver

normal_formulation.value: node-to-triangle unilateral signed-gap contact with fixed initial face/normal for friction

tangential_law.value: elastic tangential predictor followed by projection to mu*max(pressure, 0)

regularization.value: positive per-contact tangential_stiffness elastic predictor; not a smooth universal regularization

implementation_map.stick_criterion: trial tangential force norm <= Coulomb limit + contact_friction_tolerance, with prior-slip hysteresis
implementation_map.slip_criterion: otherwise project the trial force to the Coulomb limit and update slip_reference
implementation_map.friction_coefficient_source: FrictionlessContact.friction_coefficient, validated by ContactSchemaValidator for JSON input
implementation_map.rollback_owner: StateTransaction around the committed slip-reference array
implementation_map.commit_point: after a load increment converges, before the next load increment
implementation_map.search_mode_support: initial only for frictional contact; updated explicitly rejected
implementation_map.finite_sliding_support: frictionless common penalty only; frictional finite sliding rejected
implementation_map.dissipation_tracking: cumulative_local_dissipation from slip-reference work; internal positivity only

state_transaction_audit.friction_state: slip_references are copied for trial iteration and committed per converged static load increment
state_transaction_audit.trial_mutation: local copies only; beginning-of-increment committed references remain frozen during iterations
state_transaction_audit.rollback: NumericalConvergenceError path calls StateTransaction.rollback and protects committed state with a digest

coulomb_law.pressure_sign: normal Lagrange multiplier is mapped to positive compression pressure
coulomb_law.stick: trial norm inside the limit, subject to tolerance and prior-slip hysteresis
coulomb_law.slip: radial projection to the limit and slip-reference update
coulomb_law.negative_or_nonfinite_mu: rejected by JSON input schema; direct dataclass construction remains a validation boundary
coulomb_law.zero_pressure: zero Coulomb limit; undefined active-slip direction fails closed through numerical error path
coulomb_law.opening: zero tangential force and retained slip reference
coulomb_law.reversal: covered in tiny analytical/load-history evidence, not general structural qualification
coulomb_law.small_increment: tolerance/hysteresis classified, no dedicated transition V&V

tangent_audit.basis: no independent global tangent finite-difference qualification exists in the current evidence

minimum_future_state: ordered contact topology and face orientation

existing_evidence.historical_scope: experimental/internal; external harness has non-identical formulation mapping

critical: frictional contact is not integrated with the common nonlinear driver
no injected-failure digest proof for rejected friction trial
no independent formulation-matched structural reference for both formulations
major: separate regularization energy and irreversible dissipation identity
zero-pressure, direct-construction coefficient and nonfinite diagnostics tests
mesh refinement and compatible external/reference comparison

proposed_wp08_split.scope: replay, restart, negative controls and closure

prospective_bounded_scope: small displacement and small/moderate tangential motion
per-contact mu >= 0 and positive tangential stiffness for positive mu
elastic tangential predictor and Coulomb projection
homogeneous material scope inherited from the selected static route
explicit_exclusions: transient, harmonic, modal and buckling frictional contact
friction-specific checkpoint/restart until state serialization is qualified
universal smooth tangent, energy or dissipation claims
external equivalence with incompatible reference formulations

governance.next_step: Owner review of WP08 readiness; no implementation before review
